hug.description: Shrinks the tab width to fit its content instead of using the default fixed width. When enabled, the tab will use width: fit-content and a minimum width. Default: false

centerContent.description: Centers the content (icon, title, badge) horizontally within the tab. When enabled, content is centered rather than left-aligned. Default: false

checked.description: Marks the tab as selected/active. Only one tab in a group should have checked set to true. Default: false

hasClose.description: Displays a close button at the end of the tab. Use for tabs that can be removed by the user. Default: false

hasLeadingIcon.description: Shows a leading icon at the start of the tab. Supply icon content via the leading-icon slot. Default: false

hasTitle.description: Whether the tab draws its title (and subtitle). The tab row always sets it.

hasDivider.description: Shows a vertical divider on the left edge of the tab (except when checked). Useful for visually separating tabs. Default: false Available when checked==false.

title.description: The tab's title/label text. Can be overridden by slotting content into the title slot. Default: 'Tab title'

showSubtitle.description: Shows contextual text below the tab title. Default: false

subtitle.description: Contextual text shown below the tab title when showSubtitle is true. Default: ''

disabled.description: Disables the tab, preventing user interaction and applying disabled styles. Default: false

badgeType.description: The type of the badge drawn while `hasBadge` is true.

badgeCount.description: The number in the badge while `hasBadge` is true.

leadingIconName.description: The icon in the `leading-icon` slot, by name (a bundled icon); empty puts none. Slot for the leading icon (shown when hasLeadingIcon is true)

badgeIconName.description: The icon in the `badge-icon` slot, by name (a bundled icon); empty puts none. Slot for an icon inside the badge (shown when hasBadge and showLeadingBadgeIcon are true)

componentSize.description: Component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
